alphaearth_supervised_partition.title: AlphaEarth supervised partition
alphaearth_supervised_partition.target: cumulative phase shares q2-q5; crisis = q3 >= 0.20
alphaearth_supervised_partition.one_line: Tests whether frozen 2017 AlphaEarth satellite-embedding descriptors and supervised regional calibration improve IPCCH phase-share forecasts over a matched pooled XGBoost model, separately at leads 1/3/6/12 months.
alphaearth_supervised_partition.status: Supervisor accepted (task 10-10): no qualifying lead; every lead selected the shared-calibration fallback, so regional_calibration equals shared_calibration (structural zero gain). Replay 488/488 after a reviewed analysis-only amendment. Retrospective: 2023-2026 had already been inspected.
alphaearth_supervised_partition.data: Unit: IPCCH admin area x target month (6,224 admins, 42,695 valid label rows). Labels: IPC-compatible population shares phase1..phase5 (phase5 zero-filled if missing; shares in [0,1], sum in [0.90,1.10], population > 0). Targets: cumulative shares q2..q5 (share in phase >= k). Forecast origin O = end of month O; target month = O + lead. Main evaluation: targets 2023-2025 (first target 2023-02/04/07, 2024-01 for leads 1/3/6/12; 122 main target-month folds summed over the four leads); supplement: target months 2026-01..04. Development years 2021-2022; maps frozen at 2022-12.

features.groups: compact296 (296, ordered list sha e97388f8...): static (29): AEZ/geography one-hots e.g. AEZ_32000; ordinary (120): monthly predictors value/ma3/ma6/ma12 at origin e.g. GPP_mean__value_at_origin, GPP_mean__ma3_at_origin; same_month_z (56): z-score vs same calendar month history e.g. GPP_mean__hist_same_month_z_at_origin; stress (28): vegetation/climate stress share/run/months-since over 12 months e.g. GPP_mean__vegetation_stress__share12_at_origin; growing_season (29): last completed growing-season climate aggregates e.g. gs_last1__prcp_anom_gs_ensmean__at_origin; identifier (27): lat, lon, month one-hots; history (5): IPC overall-phase history e.g. overall_phase_history_1, overall_phase_history_change_1_2; idp (2): idp_admin0_latest_stock, idp_admin0_latest_age_months.

alphaearth_supervised_partition.feature_engineering: All inputs are observed at or before the forecast origin (rule D29): fit labels have target month U <= fit origin; row inputs have observation/report month <= origin; a growing season counts only if it ended before the first day of O+1. Monthly predictors are summarised at origin as current value, 3/6/12-month means, same-calendar-month z-scores and 12-month stress indicators; growing-season blocks use the last completed season. Missing values stay NaN (native XGBoost handling); infinities stop preparation. AlphaEarth descriptors (pooled_plus_alphaearth and later arms): 2017 GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL (dataset 1.1, model 2.1), 64 bands A00..A63 nearest-sampled onto a fixed equal-area 10 m grid (EPSG:6933), area-weighted (pixel area x fractional admin-boundary weight) mean and SD per admin -> 128 static columns ae2017_mean_A00..A63, ae2017_sd_A00..A63; admins with coverage < 0.80 are unusable.
alphaearth_supervised_partition.architecture: Four XGBoost regressors (q2, q3, q4, q5) per fit block predict cumulative shares; outputs are projected to 1 >= q2 >= q3 >= q4 >= q5 >= 0 (bounded equal-weight decreasing isotonic least squares, then clip); four-class phase decoded from the 0.20 rule (highest k with q_k >= 0.20); crisis = phases 3-5. Calibration arms correct the pooled_plus_alphaearth raw prediction with a ridge model on 8 slots: intercept, z_pred, z-scored 3-month precipitation anomaly, temperature anomaly and violence-event count at origin, and their missingness flags (m_prcp, m_tmean, m_violence). regional_calibration adds region-specific deviations on a supervised partition map (tree depth <= 3, leaf budgets 2/4/8, 9 cuts per AlphaEarth descriptor, support >= 200 effective rows, 50 admins, 6 target months); no map passed the development guards, so it uses the shared calibration.
alphaearth_supervised_partition.settings: XGBoost (objective reg:squarederror, tree_method hist, cpu, gbtree, seed 42, n_jobs 16, n_estimators 200, learning_rate 0.1, no early stopping, scale_pos_weight 1): q2/q4/q5 max_depth 11, subsample 1.0, colsample_bytree 0.5, gamma 0, min_child_weight 0, reg_alpha 0, reg_lambda 1; q3 max_depth 9, subsample 0.5, colsample_bytree 0.7, gamma 0.1. Sample weights 2^(-(fit_origin - U)/24) (24-month half-life), unnormalised. Annual refit at each block's fit origin on every eligible label from 2014-01 to the origin. Calibration: shared ridge lambda 0.01; regional lambdas 0.01/0.1/1.0. Phase threshold 0.20 (>=). Fit ceiling: 61 quartets (23 pooled, 38 with AlphaEarth), 244 scalar fits.

AlphaEarth extraction: separate interpreter, earthengine-api 1.7.36. Seeds: XGBoost 42; bootstrap 42.
alphaearth_supervised_partition.evaluation: Same keys per lead for all arms. Cohorts: all_scored and persistence_available (rows where the persistence comparator exists); periods primary (main 2023-2025) and holdout (2026-01..04). Metrics: binary crisis precision/recall/F1/F2/accuracy, four-class accuracy/macro-F1, projected q3 R2. Decision rule for G vs shared_calibration: main F1 gain >= 0.005 with country-cluster bootstrap (20,000 draws, seed 42, 1.25th percentile lower bound, family of 4 leads) and guards (classification -0.01, R2 -0.02). Comparators: pooled, persistence.

Availability: observation-month end <= origin (release timing not verified). geoxgb_reference.architecture: Four XGBoost regressors (q2..q5) per fit; outputs projected to 1 >= q2 >= q3 >= q4 >= q5 >= 0 (bounded equal-weight decreasing isotonic, unrounded) and decoded to phase with the 0.20 rule. Regional models continue the immutable global booster with appended shallow trees (local recipes). A historical gate (<= 6 dates) decides per region whether the regional model or the pooled model is used.

compact_climate_global.feature_engineering: Inputs are rebuilt directly at the origin O without carrier masks (D16); each feature respects its row's own origin. Saved missingness is kept: NA handled natively by XGBoost, no external scaling, imputation or feature selection. Monthly sources are summarised at O as value, 3/6/12-month means and 12-month SD, same-calendar-month z-scores and stress indicators; growing-season blocks use the two most recent completed seasons. Static context is retrospective (historical vintage not certified). The codebook records formula, unit, source, time relative to origin and missing semantics for every predictor.
compact_climate_global.architecture: Four XGBoost regressors (sklearn XGBRegressor, objective reg:squarederror) predict cumulative shares q2..q5 (phase 2 or worse .. phase 5); the IPC phase is the highest phase whose unrounded cumulative score is >= 0.20. One fit per evaluation year (annual blocks) on all areas; boosters saved per block (16 per lead for 2022-2025, 4 more in the 2026 extension). The weather oracle arm appends realized monthly anomalies.

somalia_calibrated_observed.model_type: Somalia-local XGBoost regressors of cumulative shares
somalia_calibrated_observed.target: q3 share and phase (0.20 rule); crisis truth = reported phase >= 3
somalia_calibrated_observed.one_line: Per-origin selected and calibrated share-history (D) model, 2022-2026; observed raw labels in every role (fit, selection, calibration, test).
somalia_calibrated_observed.status: Retrospective oracle-information evaluation (ideal label availability, realized future weather); not operational forecast skill. The two label scenarios are evaluated on their own populations; score differences between settings are not augmentation effects and are not ranked.
somalia_calibrated_observed.data: Unit: Somalia area x target month (Somalia-local fits only). Truth: reported overall phase (crisis truth = reported overall phase >= 3; never a threshold on the actual q3 share) and the actual population share in phase 3 or worse (q3). Outer test years 2025 and 2026; at H > 0 the primary cohort keeps only rows whose realized weather at the oracle offsets is verified (frozen before fitting), so H3/H6 primary cohorts are small (e.g. 275 rows in 2025).

features.groups: Information sets: A existing Somalia predictors (511 inputs; 376 at 12 months); B = A + 14 seasonal climate means (525; 390); C = B + realized rainfall/temperature after the origin (weather oracle: 531/537/402 at 3/6/12 months); D = C + rich population-share history (+472: 997/1003/1009/874 at 0/3/6/12 months). The ordered column list was not archived with this snapshot.

somalia_calibrated_observed.feature_engineering: Retrospective oracle-information design: ideal label publication and realized future weather at the oracle offsets (not operational skill). Population-share history (q2..q5 history features) uses labels visible under the ideal-publication assumption; residual formulations predict the q3 change from the latest observed share hist_q3_obs1 (direct fallback where no history). NA handled natively by XGBoost.
somalia_calibrated_observed.architecture: Somalia-local XGBoost regressors of the cumulative shares q2..q5 (q3 = phase 3 or worse); the phase follows the 0.20 rule. Fitted only on Somalia areas. Each (setting, outer year, horizon, origin) selects its own recipe out of fold and refits.
somalia_calibrated_observed.settings: Tree bundles (configs/somalia_oracle_candidates.json, objective reg:squarederror, random_state 42, hist, n_jobs 1; q3 overrides subsample 0.5, colsample 0.7, gamma 0.1): X1 depth 3/200 trees/lr 0.05; X2 5/200/0.05; X3 5/500/0.05; X4 7/200/0.05; X5 7/500/0.05 (all colsample 0.5, min_child_weight 5); X6 depth 11 (q3 9)/200/lr 0.1, min_child_weight 0. Sample weights decay with half-life 24 months from each inner or outer fit origin; phase threshold 0.20. Per-context grid: 6 bundles x 4 half-lives (12, 24, 48 months, none) x direct/residual x none/shift/isotonic = 144 recipes, selected by pooled training-period OOF final-q3 RMSE (AUC breaks ties) (configs/somalia_v4_calibrated_d.json).
somalia_calibrated_observed.environment: Code a7872576; mode full (summary.md); versions not recorded.
somalia_calibrated_observed.evaluation: Primary cohort per test year and lead; q3 final/raw R2, RMSE/MAE/bias (pp), final AUC, within-month AUC, binary F1/precision/recall (prediction rule q3_final >= 0.20); bootstrap 2,000 draws (seed 42). Retrospective (2025/2026 outcomes already inspected in v1).
